reviews.title: Trial lies
reviews.text: Yunno. I’m all for people quitting right? But I’m not all for shady apps doing shady things like stating they have a 7 day free trial. However when you click on the button to start your trial it only gives you a 3 day trial. Which leads me to believe one thing. That this app is lying to us all to try and convince us to do the trial just so they can surprise charge you 3 days into your “7 day free trial”. Also the app isn’t that cool anyways. Just make a note on your phone and make a mark each time you hit it then slowly lower your number of hits yourself. It’s super simple math so this app isn’t offering anything amazing to be charging 9.99$ a week like they are. Honestly. I hope the creators ate that Taco Bell lettuce and got explosive diarrhea.

Wayyyyy better bc this whole “you have to pay for everything and anything” stuff is absolutely ridiculous.

reviews.title: Get ready to pay

I did find an app that is almost the TWIN to this one & it is called “Puff Count” with a purple vape & a dark background as their logo so go check that one out, if only been using it for a little while & it hasn’t asked me for payment info (yet! lol we will see) good luck to all my fellow people out their trying to quit or cut down or just watch their vaping! Y’all got this 🫂

reviews.title: Does Its Job

It’s pretty expensive though, 10 bucks a week is fairly pricey. But I can’t lie, it’s the only app puff tracker on the App Store that is overall itself a great application. My only complaint is the price.

reviews.title: Never Deleted so Fast. Too Bad.
reviews.text: This app seems really cool, but when I have to spend more on it per week than I do on vaping, it’s not very motivating. As soon as that “choose your plan, start your free trial!” screen popped up, I deleted it. Offer a simple counter for free, then you can suggest the other features for a price as the user uses the app. If it were like that, I’d use it.

reviews.title: Ok fine here’s my review
reviews.text: I can achieve the same vibe with a tally counter app that also has a timer functionality. Many free options. This app does almost the same thing but with a themed wrapping and charges people $10 a week (?!?!?!?!?) or $59 a year. I buy cheap lava bars for $10 and they last me two weeks. I would be paying MORE money weekly than I spend on vapes. Not everyone has the disposable income to buy a year-long subscription for an app, especially the people who are statistically more likely to vape. It’s nice that the devs are pretending to care about people’s health, but for everyone else: look somewhere else, it’s just a money grab. Don’t be vulnerable here
